status_definitions.EXPLICIT: Persisted in a run artifact or unavoidably fixed by the authoritative source used for the run.
status_definitions.INFERRED: Supported by README commands and/or source defaults but not persisted as the actual invocation.
status_definitions.UNKNOWN: Evidence does not establish a value.

random_seed.evidence: Baseline CLI default; the seed is absent from result artifacts and the actual command line was not saved.

image_dimensions.evidence: Each committed table8 records image size 128; source forces three-channel JPEG decode.

batch_size.evidence: README gives batch size 32 for all four K commands and source defaults to 32; table8 is a placeholder rather than a saved value. Exact checkpoint metric matching at batch size 32 is strong retrospective confirmation.

epochs.evidence: README gives 50 epochs for all four K commands and source defaults to 50; table8 does not persist the actual value.

learning_rate.evidence: Source default; README commands omit --lr and table8 contains only a placeholder.

reconstruction_weight.evidence: Persisted loss string in each table8 and authoritative source.

classification_weight.evidence: Persisted loss string in each table8 and authoritative source.

kl_weight.evidence: Persisted loss string in each table8 and authoritative source.

archetype_simplex_weight.evidence: Persisted loss string in each table8 and authoritative source.

coefficient_entropy_training_weight.evidence: No entropy term exists in the final May source; entropy is computed only during post-training evaluation.

optimizer.evidence: Optimizer is fixed in the authoritative training source.

dataset_path_behavior.value: Explicit --labels_csv and --img_dirs accepted; otherwise discovery under --downloads_dir (default user Downloads). Image index is built from *.jpg and missing metadata rows are dropped.
dataset_path_behavior.evidence: Authoritative source. Committed per-image tables retain C:\Users\User\Downloads paths for both HAM10000 image-part directories.

split_fractions.evidence: Source defaults and reconstructed 8013/1001/1001 split match every committed test table, but the actual CLI fractions were not persisted.

split_algorithm.value: One numpy.random.default_rng(seed), iterate sorted integer labels, shuffle metadata indices per class, test=first round(n*test_frac), validation=next round(n*val_frac), train=remainder; image-level, no lesion grouping.
split_algorithm.evidence: Authoritative source; reconstructed test order produces exact checkpoint metrics and committed per-image ordering.

preprocessing.value: Read JPEG bytes; tf.image.decode_jpeg(channels=3); bilinear resize to 128x128; cast float32; divide by 255; no augmentation.

evaluation_behavior.value: Final checkpoint, deterministic t=mu with training=False; unshuffled test order; MSE per pixel and classification per image; KL and simplex reported as unweighted mean of batch means; entropy normalized by log(K); sparsity=1-mean entropy; active threshold 0.10.
evaluation_behavior.evidence: Authoritative source and exact checkpoint reproduction.

model_selection.value: Final epoch weights; no early stopping or best-checkpoint selection in source.
model_selection.evidence: Authoritative source saves after completing the epoch loop.
